_doc: Policy for tests/lib/check-doc-links.py — the guarantee that every relative
markdown link, markdown anchor fragment, and docs/*.html href resolves to
There is deliberately no path-exemption list for individual broken links
here: every false-positive trap this checker had to solve (the
directory-target links, the docs/setup/ hash-router hrefs) is solved by a
generic rule in code, not a per-path allowlist entry, so a new file in any
of those shapes needs no edit here to be handled correctly.
`excluded_files` lists whole files this checker deliberately never opens,
with the reason each is excluded, so the exclusion is a stated decision
and not a silent gap discoverable only by reading the source.
`shape_guards` catches an extractor that has quietly stopped matching —

excluded_files.plugins/agentic-sdlc/sdlc.html: owned by check-html-refs.py; its one src= is a JS template literal inside <script>, not markup — a generic href/src regex here would misfire on sdlc.html
excluded_files.docs/setup/app.js: hash-router source; '#'+id strings are client-side view state, not document anchors
